thresholds.comment: Context: orange warn at 40%, red COMPACT banner + one desktop notification at 50%. Session/weekly turn orange at their warn pct, red near exhaustion.

alerts.comment: Desktop notification (macOS/Linux) once per session when context crosses critical. Re-arms after you compact or restart.

sections.comment: session = 5h rate-limit window, weekly = 7-day window, both from Claude Code's own rate_limits data. active_sessions counts Claude Code sessions on THIS machine only.
